# devgod

> Standalone product-engineering skill for coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex). A thin `SKILL.md` router loads only the modules a task needs across TypeScript, Python, Rust, Next.js, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, and Supabase, plus deterministic scanners, CI templates, slash commands, and evals. Loop: research, plan, build, browser QA, measure, enforce, ship, improve.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): positioning, install, verbs, trust, telemetry
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): the router the agent reads first; hard gates and module triggers
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): first session walkthrough
